title: McDonalds Meals
description: This mod adds Mcdonalds! I hope you enjoy!
body:
This mod adds McDonalds to minecraft.
I know that there are many McDonalds mods out there, but I wanted to make my own and i hope you use this one.
I also really hope you enjoy.
Like my other mods, this was made with Mcreator.
Oh also you can craft all the things in the mod.
This mod currently has:
Hamburgers, fries, a chocolate milkshake, a chickenburger and corresponding meals.
There is a new villager that will sell you everything.
(there is also a creative mode tab with everything)
I plan to reguarly update this mod over time.
